items.action: None, unless a chart has to follow the pointer after a click: set pinOnClick="false" on it (cursorPin="false" on ds-chart), or DS_CONFIG.chart.pinOnClick: false for every chart. Delete a pinOnClick binding that only restates true (delete list: chart-pin-on-click-redundant, chart-cursor-pin-redundant).
items.appliesWhen: Every chart that leaves pinOnClick unbound - ds-bar-chart, ds-column-chart, ds-funnel-chart, ds-line-chart, ds-pie-chart, ds-heatmap-chart, ds-scatter-chart, a hand-composed ds-chart (cursorPin) and its dsColumnSeries / dsLineSeries marks. A chart binding pinOnClick either way keeps what it binds.
items.pitfall: A click that only selected something now also holds the tooltip and dims the rest until a second click, Escape or a press elsewhere, which reads as a stuck tooltip on a screen that never expected one.
items.verify: On every chart screen, clicking a mark and moving away either leaves the mark held with a pin disc on it, or the chart or the app config sets pinOnClick false.
items.note: The default was false, now DS_CONFIG.chart.pinOnClick and then true. A held mark shows a pin disc on itself.

items.action: None, unless something asserts on a chart tooltip or highlight straight after a hover: wait 500 ms first, or set DS_CONFIG.chart.hoverDelayMs: 0 in that test's providers.
items.appliesWhen: Every chart's pointer hover on a mark, a category, a legend entry, a heat map scale step or a bar label. Focus, a tap and a click that pins answer at once, so keyboard and touch tests are unaffected.
items.pitfall: An end-to-end test that hovers and reads the tooltip in the same step now finds no tooltip and fails, or passes on a stale panel from an earlier hover.
items.verify: Every test that hovers a chart and reads its tooltip or highlight either waits at least 500 ms or runs under hoverDelayMs: 0.
items.note: A resting pointer waits DS_CONFIG.chart.hoverDelayMs, default 500, before a chart answers; once it has, the next mark answers at once until the pointer leaves the chart.

items.action: Where your code reads pinOnClick() or cursorPin() back from a chart reference, handle null, or read pinOnClickResolved() on dsColumnSeries / dsLineSeries and cursorPinResolved() on ds-chart.
items.appliesWhen: Only TypeScript reading the raw input through viewChild or a template reference, or a subclass redeclaring it, on ds-bar-chart, ds-column-chart, ds-funnel-chart, ds-line-chart, ds-pie-chart, dsColumnSeries, dsLineSeries and ds-chart. Binding the inputs in a template is unaffected.
items.pitfall: A reader testing pinOnClick() for truthiness now sees null on an unset chart that does pin, and takes the other branch with no compile error.
items.verify: Every read of pinOnClick() or cursorPin() handles null or reads the resolved readback.
items.note: The type was boolean, now boolean | null with null meaning unset. Writers are unaffected; readers and overriders (TS2416) break.

items.action: None, unless a mark under the category cursor has to answer the pointer on its own: set cursor="none" on that ds-chart.
items.appliesWhen: Only a ds-chart whose category cursor is on (cursor="category", or "auto" with two or more marks showing a tooltip), and its dsColumnSeries / dsLineSeries marks. The ds-column-chart preset, which has no category cursor, is unaffected.
items.pitfall: A column's own per-mark panel, with its partOfWhole share line, no longer opens on hover under the cursor: the category panel replaces it anywhere in the band, and nothing answers in the gap between two bands.
items.verify: On each ds-chart with the category cursor, the pointer anywhere in a category's band opens one panel for that category, and the pointer between two bands opens nothing.
items.note: The band answered the whole category step and the tooltip only the mark's own hover box; both now answer the drawn band. A mark of your own reads CHART_SCALES.cursorOn to leave pointer hover to the band.

items.action: None, unless a chart's marks have to arrive all at once: set staggerMs="0" on it.
items.appliesWhen: ds-bar-chart, ds-column-chart, ds-line-chart, ds-funnel-chart and the dsColumnSeries / dsLineSeries marks with no staggerMs binding. A chart binding staggerMs keeps its value, now spread evenly within 260ms.
items.pitfall: A visual regression test that screenshots a chart a fixed time after it renders now catches later marks still arriving.
items.verify: Each chart either lets its marks arrive in order within about a quarter second, or binds staggerMs="0".
items.note: The default was 0, now 40 (60 on ds-funnel-chart), and the stagger spreads evenly within --ds-motion-chart-mark-stagger-budget rather than stopping at a 300ms cap.

items.old: BarChartComponent, ChartComponent, ColumnChartComponent, ColumnSeriesComponent, LineChartComponent, LineSeriesComponent, FunnelChartComponent, HeatmapChartComponent, PieChartComponent, ScatterChartComponent, PaginationComponent, ChartLegendComponent, ChartTooltipPanelComponent, WaterfallMarksComponent
items.action: Build after upgrading, rename or mark `override` every member of yours the compiler reports as colliding, and delete an override whose base member is gone.
items.appliesWhen: Subclassing a DS component is unsupported, but consumers do it. Template users of the listed components need nothing.
items.pitfall: `protected` and `private` are no protection: a redeclared member collides exactly as a public one does. A method of yours named like a removed member and declared without `override` still compiles, and is simply never called again.
items.verify: The app builds with no TS4114 or TS2416 against a DS base class, and no subclass keeps a member named after a removed one.
items.note: The chart components gained the pinning, hover-delay and label-highlight members, PaginationComponent gained empty; five protected members of ColumnSeriesComponent are gone (pinDiscRadius, pinGlyph, pinGlyphOffset, pinGlyphSize, slotStepPx). The compiler names every collision.

items.action: None, unless you supply your own pagination.range through provideDsIntl or DS_INTL: return your empty-list wording when total is 0.
items.appliesWhen: Only an app that replaces DS_INTL.pagination.range. The default wording already reads Showing 0 of 0, and an app that never overrides the range text has nothing to do.
items.pitfall: Nothing errors: a formatter that prints first and last unconditionally now shows a range of 0 to 0 under an empty list, on every ds-pagination and in every paged ds-table announcement that falls back to it.
items.verify: A ds-pagination with total 0 shows your empty-list wording, and a paged ds-table filtered to no rows announces the same words.

items.action: None, unless you bind [rangeAnnouncement] on a paged ds-table: return your empty wording, or an empty string to stay silent, when total is 0.
items.appliesWhen: Only a paged ds-table (pageSize set) with its own rangeAnnouncement. A table without pageSize announces no range, and one without the binding follows DS_INTL.pagination.range.
items.pitfall: Nothing errors: a function that formats first and last unconditionally is now called with (0, 0, 0) when a filter or new data empties the table, and a screen reader hears a range of 0 to 0.
items.verify: A paged ds-table filtered to no rows announces your empty wording once, or nothing where your function returns an empty string.

informational: New chart entrance tokens: --ds-motion-chart-mark-grow-duration, --ds-motion-chart-mark-grow-easing, --ds-motion-chart-mark-sweep-duration, --ds-motion-chart-mark-detail-duration and --ds-motion-chart-mark-stagger-budget, on the new primitives --duration-slowest, --ease-emphasized-decelerate and --ease-settle.

informational.text: Chart entrances are slower and staged: --ds-motion-chart-mark-enter-duration is 400ms (was 180ms) with --ease-emphasized-decelerate; columns, bars and waterfall steps grow over 600ms with no fade, a solid line draws on, the pie ring turns in, funnel stages rise, points and markers settle, heat map cells fade in by column, and value labels, markers and legend swatches follow their mark. Under reduced motion every mark appears at once.
informational.verify: Load a chart page with reduced motion on and confirm every mark is on screen at once, then with it off and confirm no mark is left transparent or half drawn once the entrance ends.

informational: ds-heatmap-chart gains staggerMs, default 40, staggering its columns.
DS_CONFIG.chart.pinOnClick and DS_CONFIG.chart.hoverDelayMs set, for every chart, whether a click holds a mark (default true) and how long a resting pointer waits (default 500 ms).
ds-heatmap-chart and ds-scatter-chart gain pinOnClick, with an Unpin control.

informational.text: A held mark shows a pin disc on itself on every chart: column, bar, slice, funnel stage, heat map cell, scatter point, line marker, and a category held under the category cursor, with its disc at the foot of the band.
informational.verify: Click a mark on each chart type and confirm a pin disc appears on the held mark.

informational: The pointer cursor appears over a mark a click would hold, a mark set interactive, and a category band under the category cursor when a press holds it; the gap between two bands keeps the default cursor.

Naming a series or a category highlights it on every chart: a funnel stage row dims the other stages whatever dimOthers says, a heat map scale step dims every cell outside it, and a bar label or a ds-chart category label (ds-waterfall-chart included) dims the other bars.
dimOthers follows the mark the chart has answered rather than the raw hover, so the fade waits out the hover delay with the tooltip and follows focus.

informational.text: A column's hover area stops at its category's band (was: up to the whole step between two columns), so the gap between two columns answers no pointer.
informational.verify: Point between two columns of a ds-column-chart and confirm no tooltip opens.

informational: A chart tooltip fades in rather than scaling in, so its rows no longer drift into place each time it opens on another mark; --ds-overlay-enter-keyframes still overrides it, and every other overlay keeps its scale.

A category tooltip lists its readings top to bottom, in the order their marks are drawn at that category (was: the order the series were declared); the legend keeps the declared order. A mark of your own that reports readings through CHART_SCALES places each one with y, its height in plot pixels from the top.

informational.text: A hatched column's stripes run from bottom left to top right, and the tooltip swatch's stripe runs the same way.
informational.verify: Open the tooltip of a hatched column and confirm the swatch stripe and the column stripes slant the same way.

informational.text: A tooltip swatch is ringed only when its colour sits below 3:1 against the tooltip background, with a 1.5px ring in the tooltip's text colour drawn inside the 12px dot; every other swatch has no ring.
informational.verify: Hover a dark series on the light theme and a mid-tone one, and confirm only the dark one's swatch is ringed and both are 12px.

informational.text: The ds-tooltip panel wraps a value with no break opportunity (a long file name or id) inside its max width instead of running past its edge.
informational.verify: Hover a tooltip whose text is one unbroken 60-character token and confirm it breaks onto a second line inside the dark panel.

informational.text: ds-select, ds-autocomplete and ds-multi-select show a clipped trigger value or option label in full in a tooltip on hover; a label that fits shows none. A [title]= set on the picker only to repeat that label now shows a second, native tooltip beside it (delete list: picker-title-repeating-clipped-label).
informational.verify: In a narrow ds-select, hover the closed trigger holding a long value and each long option in the open list: one dark tooltip shows the whole label, and a short label shows none.

informational.text: ds-pagination with total 0 disables every page button and marks none as current (page 1 was highlighted and carried aria-current).
informational.verify: Render a ds-pagination with total 0: the range reads Showing 0 of 0, every button is disabled, and no button is highlighted or carries aria-current.

informational.text: The Unpin control sits at the top end of a chart, on its caption's line, and the caption leaves room for it while it shows; a chart with no caption gains the line.
informational.verify: Pin a mark on a chart with a caption and on one without, and confirm the Unpin control covers no axis label, legend entry, table cell or caption text.

deleteList.why: A click holds a mark by default, so a binding of true restates it. It still does something where DS_CONFIG.chart.pinOnClick is false and this chart is the exception, and may stay there.
A press holds the category cursor by default, so a binding of true restates it. It still does something where DS_CONFIG.chart.pinOnClick is false and this chart is the exception, and may stay there.

ds-select, ds-autocomplete and ds-multi-select disclose a clipped trigger value or option label in a tooltip, so a title bound on the picker to repeat that label adds a second, native tooltip. A title that carries more than the label, or one on a picker whose label never clips, may stay.
